s/        h\[16 + k\] = v;/        h[16 + k] = v + 1;/
s/        h\[k\] = (u32) v >> 16;/        h[k] = v >> 15;/
s/        f32 f = mf\[k >> 2\]\[k \& 3\] \* 65536.0f;/        f32 f = mf[k \& 3][k >> 2] * 65536.0f;/
s/                     : -(s32) ((-(f) + 8388608.0f) - 8388608.0f))/                     : (s32) (f))/
s/     : ((f) >= 0.0f) ? (s32) (((f) + 8388608.0f) - 8388608.0f)/     : ((f) >= 0.0f) ? (s32) (f)/
